verses.sanskrit:
जनमेजय उवाच।
              कथं स सगरो जातो गरेणैव सहाच्युतः। किमर्थं च शकादीनां क्षत्रियाणां महौजसाम्॥१॥
धर्मं कुलोचितं क्रुद्धो राजा निरसदच्युतः। एतन्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व विस्तरेण तपोधन॥२॥
verses.bhavadeepa: उत्पत्तिश्चरितं प्रोक्तं सगरस्य चतुर्दशे। सागरत्वं समुद्रस्य तत्पुत्रोद्यमसम्भवम्॥१॥ कथं गरेण सह सन्कथम् अच्युतो न मृत इत्यर्थः॥१॥

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              बाहोर्व्यसनिनस्तात हृतं राज्यमभूत्किल। हैहयैस्तालजङ्घैश्च शकैः सार्धं विशाम्पते॥३॥
verses.english: "How emperor सगर took birth along with poison? What for the clans like शक and others have discarded क्शत्रिय convention? And what for the emperor sagara is enraged at them and drove them off... please elucidate these points...

verses.sanskrit: यवनाः पारदाश्चैव काम्बोजाः पह्लवाः खसाः। एते ह्यपि गणाः पञ्च हैहयार्थे पराक्रमम्॥४॥
verses.english: When sagara's father bAhuka is given to irretrievable lechery, hunting and a flighty life, then the onslaught of haihaya-s, tAlaja~Ngha-s, shaka-s, has become more forceful, and then taking support of five others who are the myrmidons of haihaya-s, namely yavanA-s, pAradA-a, kAmbojA-s, pahlavA-s and khasA-s, those three usurped the kingdom of ayodhya... so they say...

verses.sanskrit: हृतराज्यस्तदा राजा स वै बाहुर्वनं ययौ। पत्न्या चानुगतो दुःखी वने प्राणानवासृजत्॥५॥
verses.english: When the kingdom is usurped thus, then king bAhuka went to woods to live in misery, just his wives helping him, where he breathed his last. At that time, when his prime-wife who belonged to यदु dynasty has become pregnant, other co-wives became envious of her pregnancy and administered poison to her- so we hear...
verses.bhavadeepa: पञ्च शकादयः हैहया इति तालजङ्घा इति चैको राशिः। तदर्थे हैहयार्थं तद्राज्यसाधनार्थं पराक्रमन् पराक्रमं कृतवन्तः॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: पत्नी तु यादवी तस्य सगर्भा पृष्ठतोऽन्वगात्। सपत्न्या च गरस्तस्यै दत्तः पूर्वमभूत्किल॥६॥
verses.english: She desperately arranged a pyre for her husband and she too mounted it for self-immolation. But, noticing the futurity of her pregnancy, godly sage और्व thoughtfully averted it, and brought her to his hermitage, where she delivered the king sagara, who took birth along with the poison earlier administered to his mother by her co-wives...

verses.sanskrit: सा तु भर्तुश्चितां कृत्वा वने तामध्यरोहत। और्वस्तां भार्गवस्तात कारुण्यात्समवारयत्॥७॥
verses.english: Sage aurva himself performed the boyhood ceremonies like naming, letter-writing, upanayana etc. ceremonies, and taught Vedic scriptures to him. Besides, he gave him a deadly missile called आग्नेय-अस्त्रम्, which is an uncontainable weapon even to gods...

verses.sanskrit: तस्याश्रमे च तं गर्भं गरेणैव सहाच्युतम्। व्यजायत महाबाहुं सगरं नाम पार्थिवम्॥८॥
verses.english: Then sagara with his might, and that of the missile he possessed, started annihilating haihaya-s ruthlessly, as god rudra would be annihilating living being at the end of era... then he embarked to wipe out shaka-a, yavanA-s, kAmboja-s, pArada-s, and pahlavA-s completely. When sagara started eliminating them thus, then they reverently sought the refuge of noble-minded vashiSTha. Noticing their plight the high-minded vashiSTha gave them a safe haven and dissuaded king sagara from that onslaught...

verses.sanskrit: और्वस्तु जातकर्मादि तस्य कृत्वा महात्मनः। अध्याप्य वेदशास्त्राणि ततोऽस्त्रं प्रत्यपादयत्॥९॥
verses.english: Holding on to his own pledge to root out incompatibles, also keeping the promise given by his mentor to the same folks in view, sagara let them off ordering a different identity for them. He ordered half-shaved heads to shaka-s; clean-shaven heads to yavanA-s; pArada-s and kAmbojA-s to hang their head hair loose; pahlavA-s shall grow beards. He debarred them all from the study of Vedic text and scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: आग्नेयं तु महाघोरममरैरपि दुःसहम्। स तेनास्त्रबलेनाजौ बलेन च समन्वितः॥१०॥
verses.english: In fact, all the shaka-s, yavanA-s, kAmboja-s, pArada-s, koli-sarpa-s, mahiSha-s, dArdya-s chola-s, and kerala-s, are kshatriya-s only... but, emperor sagara precluded them from kshatriya dharma for their unprincipled actions, according to the verdict of sage vashiSTha.

verses.sanskrit: हैहयान्निजघानाशु क्रुद्धो रुद्रः पशूनिव। आजहार च लोकेषु कीर्तिं कीर्तिमतां वरः॥११॥
verses.english: On conquering kings of खसा, पार, चोल, मद्र, किष्किन्ध, कुन्तल, वन्ग, कोन्कण provinces, and to become a righteous conqueror of the world he undertook the vow for ashwa-medha ritual, horse-sacrifice ritual, and released the horse, challenging any king who dares to capture that horse.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शकान्सयवनान्काम्बोजान्पारदांस्तदा। पह्लवांश्चैव निःशेषान्कर्तुं व्यवसितस्तदा॥१२॥
verses.english: While that horse is being moved around provinces it reached the south-easterly zone, and at seashore indra abducted that horse and hid it underneath the earth. sagara then ordered his sons escorting that horse to dig up that place to locate the ritual horse.

verses.sanskrit: ते वध्यमाना वीरेण सगरेण महात्मना। वसिष्ठं शरणं गत्वा प्रणिपेतुर्मनीषिणम्॥१३॥
verses.english: Then sagara with his might, and that of the missile he possessed, started annihilating haihaya-s ruthlessly, as god rudra would be annihilating living being at the end of era... then he embarked to wipe out shaka-a, yavanA-s, kAmboja-s, pArada-s, and pahlavA-s completely. When sagara started eliminating them thus, then they reverently sought the refuge of noble-minded vashiSTha. Noticing their plight the high-minded vashiSTha gave them a safe haven and dissuaded king sagara from that onslaught...

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठस्त्वथ तान्दृष्ट्वा समयेन महाद्युतिः। सगरं वारयामास तेषां दत्त्वाभयं तदा॥१४॥
verses.english: Awakened by their digging sage kapila opened his eyes, and those eyes have opened fire and burnt all the sons of emperor sagara, excluding four, namely barha-ketu, su-ketu, dharma-ratha and the valiant pa~ncha-jana, who are scheduled to further the lineage of sagara.

verses.sanskrit: सगरः स्वां प्रतिज्ञां च गुरोर्वाक्यं निशम्य च। धर्मं जघान तेषां वै वेषान्यत्वं चकार ह॥१५॥
verses.english: श्रीहरि donning the role of sage kapila accorded boons to those four sons of sagara, saying "let there be eternality for ikshvAku dynasty, let that dynasty have an unvarying renown, let समुद्र, ocean-god, take birth in your lineage, let you all have unreduced stay in heave, let your brothers too, burnt by the heat if my eyes, have eternal abode in heaven..."

verses.sanskrit: अर्द्धं शकानां शिरसो मुण्डं कृत्वा व्यसर्जयत्। यवनानां शिरः सर्वं काम्बोजानां तथैव च॥१६॥
verses.english: Holding on to his own pledge to root out incompatibles, also keeping the promise given by his mentor to the same folks in view, sagara let them off ordering a different identity for them. He ordered half-shaved heads to shaka-s; clean-shaven heads to yavanA-s; pArada-s and kAmbojA-s to hang their head hair loose; pahlavA-s shall grow beards. He debarred them all from the study of Vedic text and scriptures.
verses.bhavadeepa: धर्मं जघानं न क्षत्रधर्मात् च्यावितवान् यतो वेषान्यत्वं वेषान्तरं तेषां चकार॥१५॥

verses.sanskrit: पारदा मुक्तकेशाश्च पह्लवाः श्मश्रुधारिणः। निःस्वाध्यायवषट्काराः कृतास्तेन महात्मना॥१७॥
verses.english: समुद्र, the ocean-god, receiving reverence from emperor sagara venerated that king in his turn, and that king thus acquired the title of sagara, an ocean, as he dug earth to oceanic depths... sagara also performed hundred ashwa-medha, horse-rituals and begot sixty-thousand sons... thus we told...

verses.sanskrit: शका यवनकाम्बोजाः पारदाश्च विशाम्पते। कोलिसर्पाः समहिषा दार्द्याश्चोलाः सकेरलाः॥१८॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the fourteenth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the legend of emperor sagara.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे ते क्षत्रियास्तात धर्मस्तेषां निराकृतः। वसिष्ठवचनाद्राजन्सगरेण महात्मना॥१९॥
खसांस्तु पारांश्चोलांश्च मद्रान्किष्किन्धकांस्तथा। कौन्तलांश्च तथा वङ्गान्साल्वान्कौङ्कणकांस्तथा॥२०॥
स धर्मविजयी राजा विजित्येमां वसुन्धराम्। अश्वं वै प्रेरयामास वाजिमेधाय दीक्षितः॥२१॥
verses.english: On conquering kings of खसा, पार, चोल, मद्र, किष्किन्ध, कुन्तल, वन्ग, कोन्कण provinces, and to become a righteous conqueror of the world he undertook the vow for ashwa-medha ritual, horse-sacrifice ritual, and released the horse, challenging any king who dares to capture that horse.
verses.bhavadeepa: खसादीन् विजित्य इमां वसुन्धरां च विजित्य वाजिमेधाय दीक्षितो भूत्वा अस्यां भुवि अश्वं च प्रेरयामासेति द्वयोः सम्बन्धः॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्य चारयतः सोऽश्वः समुद्रे पूर्वदक्षिणे। वेलासमीपेऽपहृतो भूमिं चैव प्रवेशितः॥२२॥
स तं देशं तदा पुत्रैः खानयामास पार्थिवः। आसेदुस्ते ततस्तत्र खन्यमाने महार्णवे॥२३॥
तमादिपुरुषं देवं हरिं कृष्णं प्रजापतिम्। विष्णुं कपिलरूपेण स्वपन्तं पुरुषोत्तमम्॥२४॥
verses.bhavadeepa: ते खनन्तः पुत्राः हरिम् आसेदुरिति द्वयोः सम्बन्धः। आसेदुरित्यभिमुखं प्राप्य विषादं प्राप्ता इत्यर्थः॥२३॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्य चक्षुःसमुत्थेन तेजसा प्रतिबुध्यतः। दग्धास्ते वै महाराज चत्वारस्त्ववशेषिताः॥२५॥
verses.bhavadeepa: आदिपुरुषं प्रकृतिप्रवर्तकं हरिम् अविद्याकार्यहरं कृष्णं सदानन्दरूपप्रजायाः पतिं स्वपन्तं समाध्यवस्थितं पुरुषोत्तमम्। अन्तर्यामिणम्॥२४॥

verses.sanskrit: बर्हकेतुः सुकेतुश्च तथा धर्मरथो नृपः। शूरः पञ्चजनश्चैव तस्य वंशकरो नृपः॥२६॥
verses.bhavadeepa: तस्य प्रतिबुध्यतः योगनिद्रां त्यजतः चक्षुःसमुत्थेन तेजसा अग्निना॥२५॥

verses.sanskrit: प्रादाच्च तस्मै भगवान्हरिर्नारायणो वरान्। अक्षयं वंशमिक्ष्वाकोः कीर्तिं चाप्यनिवर्तनीम्॥२७॥
पुत्रं समुद्रं च विभुः स्वर्गवासं तथाक्षयम्। पुत्राणां चाक्षयाँलोकांस्तस्य ये चक्षुषा हताः॥२८॥
समुद्रश्चार्घमादाय ववन्दे तं महीपतिम्। सागरत्वं च लेभे स कर्मणा तेन तस्य वै॥२९॥
तं चाश्वमेधिकं सोऽश्वं समुद्रादुपलब्धवान्। आजहाराश्वमेधानां शतं स सुमहायशाः। पुत्राणां च सहस्राणि षष्ठिस्तस्येति नः श्रुतम्॥३०॥
verses.english: समुद्र, the ocean-god, receiving reverence from emperor sagara venerated that king in his turn, and that king thus acquired the title of sagara, an ocean, as he dug earth to oceanic depths... sagara also performed hundred ashwa-medha, horse-rituals and begot sixty-thousand sons... thus we told...
